strings.منوی مدیریت دسترسی‌ها فقط برای مدیر سیست: The access management menu is for the administrator only. “Show menu” is independent of the details inside that menu. Every action needs three separate layers: showing the menu, viewing the details, and the permission for the action itself. Archiving a contract, for example, can be delegated with “Contracts”, “View contracts” and “Archive contract” — it does not require permission to create or edit contracts. In the dashboard group, the personal, team, organisation and financial cards are controlled separately as well. Every control is enforced in both the interface and the API.
strings.⚠ این تاریخِ آینده‌ایست که کار باید تا آ: ⚠ This is the future date the work must be finished by — not today's date and not the day the task was handed over. Filling it in wrongly (today, for example) makes the task show up as overdue almost immediately. Leave it empty if there is no fixed deadline.
Encryption and key creation are fully automatic: no app or key is installed or entered by hand. The key is kept durably on the server, so signing in again or restarting the system never locks readable messages away.
strings.هر نقطه بازیابی شامل دیتابیس، فایل‌ها، م: Every restore point holds the database, the files, a manifest and an integrity hash. The full/differential chain is kept together and the connection string is never included. A full restore deliberately requires stopping the server and using the tool

strings.هدف کل شرکت از جمع اهداف تیم‌ها ساخته می: The company target is the sum of the team targets and cannot be edited here. The figure below is only the board-approved number, shown so the gap against the team totals is visible; it never blocks a team from setting its own target.
strings.در نسخه شبکه داخلی، پیام‌ها با کلید پاید: On the internal network build, messages are encrypted with a durable key kept in the database, so they stay readable after signing in again or restarting the server.
